subject: Sponsor concierge: EB session scheduling + MAP runbook
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acme.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor concierge: EB session scheduling + MAP runbook

Sam / Priya — looping you in to align on an executable close plan and an EB (Executive Briefing) window. We want a tight MAP that lets Acme finish the evaluation without surprises and lock by end of September. Key asks below and a proposed runbook attached.

High level:
- Two things to finalize this week: EB window (exec attendees + 60 minute slot) and evaluation sign-off criteria (MVP checklist we can validate live).
- I sketched a MAP (attached: MAP_Acme_v3.xlsx) with owner, due date, and success metric for each milestone.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Confirm EB attendees from Acme (CISO + VP Eng preferred) and availability for 9/13–9/17 (we can accommodate Pacific-friendly times).
2) Agree on the evaluation anchor: three feature tests + one latency SLA test + demo script. I included a short eval-plan in PDF.
3) Doc/permissions: request for a read-only dataset access and a sandbox with 2k-token sample inputs by 9/10 so our engineers can validate throughput.

If you prefer a quick 20-min touch to finalize attendees, I can run that today. Otherwise I’ll lock a tentative EB on 9/15 10am PT and adjust based on your reply.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Sam Patel <sam@acme.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor concierge: EB session scheduling + MAP runbook

Thanks Marcus — this looks promising. Quick answers:
- Execs: I can commit our VP Eng (Ajay Kumar) and our Head of Security (Laura Gomez). Laura prefers afternoons PT.
- Evaluation: the three feature tests are fine; can you add an acceptance threshold on token-level hallucination rate? We’ll want to see example prompts that map to our prod intents.
- Sandbox: I’ll ask our infra to standing up a read-only bucket; ETA 9/9.

Can we narrow EB slots to 9/15 2pm PT or 9/16 11am PT? Both work for Ajay (he’s flexible). Laura prefers 2pm if you need to pick one.

Also please include a short run-of-show in the invite (10m intros, 25m demo, 15m Q&A, 10m next steps).

—Sam
Principal Product Manager, Acme Corp
sam@acme.io

(Reply inline below)
> Proposed immediate next steps:
> 1) Confirm EB attendees...
> 2) Agree on the evaluation anchor...
> 3) Doc/permissions...

All good from our side — will send calendar invite once you confirm the final time.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acme.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor concierge: EB session scheduling + MAP runbook

Great — locking 9/15 2pm PT as tentative (Laura asked for afternoons and Ajay is fine). I’ll send the invite after we confirm with Marissa and Irene on staffing.

Map highlights (short):
- MAP owner: Marissa (sales ops) — deliverable: finalized MAP spreadsheet and mutual signoff by 9/10.
- Technical validation: Irene will coordinate the sandbox tests and verify throughput/latency by 9/13.
- Acceptance criteria: we’ll add a hallucination threshold (<= 3% on the supplied prompt set) and an average generation latency < 650ms for 2k-token runs.
- Procurement: legal/proc requirement itemized in the MAP (DocuSign for MSA and SOW) targeted for signature by 9/24.

I attached a slimmed run-of-show and the updated eval-plan (eval-plan-v2.pdf). Please confirm:
- Do we have the specific prompt set from Acme? If yes, share a sample (5–10 prompts) to include in the MAP.
- Who at Acme will be the final approver on the eval? (Name + title)

I’m copying Marissa to own the MAP doc and send the DocuSign links once terms are negotiated. Irene — can you confirm infra/test ETA?

Marcus

Attachments: EB-invite.ics (placeholder), eval-plan-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam@acme.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor concierge: EB session scheduling + MAP runbook

Putting the MAP under our shared document: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cMAP-runbook — I’ve updated owners and due dates. Summary of changes: 
- Added hallucination test definition + acceptance method (sample size = 200 prompts; scorer: Acme QA + Redwood seeds).
- Inserted procurement checkpoint: legal needs redline window 9/20–9/22; DocuSign sent 9/23 if no open items.
- EB invite: confirmed for 9/15 14:00 PT (Ajay Kumar, Laura Gomez, Sam Patel) — invite with run-of-show sent to execs and copied here.

Irene confirmed the sandbox access timeline (infra ticket submitted; read-only dataset available 9/9 EOD). She also wrote a short test plan in the doc for throughput checks (Irene: thanks!).

Next immediate asks for Acme: please upload the 5–10 sample prompts into the shared doc and add the final approver name under the evaluation sign-off section. Once we have that I’ll mark the MAP as ready for mutual sign-off and publish the DocuSign request.

Thanks all — we’re on track for the 9/24 signature target.

-Marissa
Director, Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: MAP_Acme_v3.xlsx, eval-plan-v2.pdf, EB-invite.ics
